'''Sakiduba''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LoNH" /> located in the [[Sakiduba system/Legends|Sakiduba system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was connected by a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Saki system/Legends|Saki system]].<ref name="LoNH" />

Sakiduba was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyans]] of the planet [[Sakiya]]&mdash;also known as Saki&mdash;with its name, which meant "Third Saki,"<ref name="LoNH" /> being shared with "duba," the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] word for "three."<ref name="Phrasebook">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> Considered a part of the group known as the [[Sakiyan Collective]], Sakiduba was established as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony to support Sakiya's growing industry of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology manufacture, and it produced the majority of raw materials used in the production of repulsorlift [[Engine/Legends|drives]]. At the [[Factory/Legends|foundries]] of Sakiduba, components were constructed that were then shipped off for assembly in Sakiya's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Kæhaxa]].<ref name="LoNH" /> The fate of the Sakiyan colony worlds, including Sakiduba, in the wake of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of Hutt Space by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="TEA" /> in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> was not well-known.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sakiduba was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
